goal: Prevent periodic wallet rebroadcasts from announcing unconfirmed transactions over clearnet P2P
Avoid revealing node ownership of wallet transactions for users opting into private broadcast
agreement: Support for protecting transactions sent outside normal wallet broadcast from leaks (andrewtoth)
Unaddressed objection: local mempool resubmission still leaks privacy to active observers (davidgumberg)

categories.name: p2p
why: P1 because it fixes a privacy leak announcing private transactions over standard P2P clearnet connections
Restores core transaction origin privacy for users running private broadcast

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it keeps periodic wallet resubmissions from deanonymizing users who opt into private broadcast
Prevents incoming dust payments or external wallet sends from triggering origin-revealing rebroadcasts
